description:
Split a person's, company's or entity's podcast mentions by who said them: the speakers' occupations (SOC 2018) or fields of research (ANZSRC 2020). Answers "who is talking about NVIDIA — investors, engineers, journalists?" in one call: each group's mention lines, share, distinct speakers and episodes over a window (default the last 30 days, at most 365), optionally bucketed by day, week or month. `speakers="guests"` leaves hosts out; `level="detailed"` splits into detailed occupations or ANZSRC groups; `podcast_slug` or `publisher_slug` narrows to one show or network.

`keyword_search` splits the lines that say a word or quoted phrase instead of an entity's mentions (who talks about prior authorization?), counting a line only when its own speaker said every word in it. Its window is at most 90 days, and a word said in too many episodes is refused with a way to narrow it. This is the per-speaker answer that `particle_podcast_get_episode_timeseries` with `keyword_search` and `guest_occupation` cannot give: that counts matching segments in episodes with such a guest, whoever spoke them.

Shares are of the mentions spoken by someone with an expertise read, and a person listed under several codes counts in each, so shares can sum past 100%.

Each group's code is a `guest_occupation` (or `guest_field`) value: pass it to `particle_podcast_find_mentions` with the same entity to read what that group said. For a keyword, `particle_podcast_search_transcripts` with the same `keyword_search` finds candidate passages: its guest filters keep segments with such a guest, so check each matching line's speaker, and host lines are not reached that way. Not for the mention lines themselves (`particle_podcast_find_mentions`) or for a brand's mention volume over time and the shows carrying it (`particle_podcast_get_mention_trends`).

by.description: Group the speakers by 'occupation' (SOC 2018, default) or 'field' (ANZSRC 2020 fields of research).

company_slug.description: Company slug or domain from particle_company_resolve (e.g. 'nvidia'). Resolves to the company's linked entity.

entity_slug.description: Knowledge-graph entity slug from particle_entity_resolve for anything that isn't a person or company (e.g. 'germany').

include_ads.description: Count mentions inside ad reads too. Off by default: ad copy is not a speaker's voice.

interval.description: Add each group's mentions per day, week or month.

keyword_search.description: Split the lines that say these words instead of an entity's mentions: every word in one line, case-insensitive; wrap words in double quotes to require them adjacent and in order. Words count as spoken, so a word with two meanings counts both. Window at most 90 days.

level.description: Group level: 'major' (default; SOC major groups or ANZSRC divisions) or 'detailed' (detailed occupations or ANZSRC groups).

limit.description: Groups to return, most mentioned first (1-50, default 10).

output_format.description: Output serialization. 'markdown' (default) returns the LLM-facing rendering. 'json' returns the structured payload as JSON text — use only for programmatic chaining where exact field extraction matters; the JSON shape is larger and noisier for an LLM to read.

person_slug.description: Person slug from particle_person_resolve (e.g. 'sam-altman'). One of person_slug, company_slug, entity_slug or keyword_search is required.

podcast_slug.description: Only mentions inside this podcast (slug from particle_podcast_resolve).

published_after.description: Only episodes published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 30 days before published_before; the window may span at most 365 days for an entity and 90 for a keyword.

published_before.description: Only episodes published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to now.

publisher_slug.description: Only mentions on podcasts of this publisher (network), by slug.

speakers.description: Whose lines count: 'all' (default, hosts included) or 'guests' (guests and panelists only).

name: particle_podcast_get_share_of_voice
title: Particle Podcast Get Share Of Voice
